rationale: The reviewed ordinary consumer calculates cuboid/cube surfaces from rectangular faces. Explaining why a rectangular face contains length times width unit squares supplies the coherent measurement foundation for that decomposition, instead of an unrelated imported topic. HB p15 explicitly combines measuring/calculating rectangle area with cuboid/cube surface area; pp7 and12 integrate explanations of mathematical procedures with content. This justifies the exact existing canonical goal as a didactic prerequisite bridge in HB, not as a separately worded original HB requirement.
